lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Laws for Sharing the Road — Bikes, Trucks & Horses
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §551.101, what legal status and rights do bicyclists hold on roadways?

options.text: Bicycles are classified as pedestrian toys with zero roadway travel rights
Bicyclists have all rights and duties applicable to motor vehicle drivers
Bicycles may only operate on sidewalks and are banned from all city streets
Bicyclists are legally required to ride facing against oncoming traffic
